name: 7 Deadly Sins
overview: The Scriptures reveal the seriousness with which God views sinful attitudes and actions, highlighting covetousness as forbidden by His command not to desire what belongs to others (Exodus 20:17). Proverbs underscores the gravity of sin by listing things the LORD hates, describing seven abominations that grieve His soul (Proverbs 6:16), including pride, which precedes destruction and a fall (Proverbs 16:18). Believers are reminded to trust in the LORD’s presence and guidance without fear (Deuteronomy 31:8), and to build their lives wisely rather than foolishly tearing them down (Proverbs 14:1). Together, these verses call Christians to recognize the destructive nature of sin and to rely on God’s strength to overcome it.
